dog.description_text:
💙 MEET SIMBA! 💙
🐶 Male | 11 weeks old | Mixed Breed
If puppy kisses are your weakness, Simba may be your downfall. 😂😘🐾
This sweet little 11-week-old boy was found abandoned with his siblings. It wasn't the beginning we would have chosen for any puppy, but Simba certainly hasn't let it stop him from loving everyone he meets. ❤️
In fact, Simba has a very important specialty…
LICKIES. Lots and lots of lickies. 😂😘
💕 Very sweet & affectionate
😘 Professional giver of puppy kisses
dog.name: SIMBA
